ch.t: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord thunders over the mighty waters.

s: Weeping may stay for the night
ch.t: Lord, when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

s: Into your hands I commit my spirit
My times are in your hands
Love the LORD, all his faithful people
ch.t: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from your sight!” Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

s: I will instruct you in the way
ch.t: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

s: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made
The eyes of the LORD are on those who fear him
ch.t: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

s: Taste and see that the LORD is good
The angel of the LORD encamps
ch.t: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him.

s: Contend with those who contend with me
They repay me evil for good
ch.t: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

s: No fear of God before their eyes
In your light we see light
ch.t: Even on their beds they plot evil; they commit themselves to a sinful course and do not reject what is wrong.

s: Do not fret because of evildoers
The meek will inherit the land
The righteous will never be forsaken
The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD
ch.t: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

s: Do not rebuke me in your anger
ch.t: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; there is no soundness in my bones because of my sin.

s: Show me the measure of my days
ch.t: When you rebuke and discipline anyone for their sin, you consume their wealth like a moth— surely everyone is but a breath.

s: He put a new song in my mouth
Here I am, I have come
ch.t: Blessed is the one who trusts in the Lord, who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

s: Blessed are those who care for the weak
Even my close friend has betrayed me
ch.t: When one of them comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it around.

s: As the deer pants for water
ch.t: I say to God my Rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?”

s: Send out your light and your truth
ch.t: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

s: Our ancestors told us what you did
You have rejected and humbled us
For your sake we face death all day long
ch.t: We have heard it with our ears, O God; our ancestors have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

s: Your throne, O God, endures forever
The royal bride in gold of Ophir
ch.t: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her— those brought to be with her.

s: God is our refuge and strength
Be still and know that I am God
ch.t: He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”

s: God has ascended amid shouts of joy
ch.t: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

s: Great is the LORD in the city of our God
This God is our God forever
ch.t: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

s: No one can redeem another's life
God will redeem me from the grave
ch.t: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings.

s: The cattle on a thousand hills are mine
ch.t: The Mighty One, God, the Lord, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to where it sets.

s: Create in me a clean heart
ch.t: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

s: The righteous flourish like olive trees
ch.t: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty hero? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?
Do all these evildoers know nothing? They devour my people as though eating bread; they never call on God.
Arrogant foes are attacking me; ruthless people are trying to kill me— people without regard for God.

s: Wings of a dove to escape
Cast your burden on the Lord
ch.t: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship at the house of God, as we walked about among the worshipers.

s: When I am afraid I trust
You have kept count of my tears
ch.t: Be merciful to me, my God, for my enemies are in hot pursuit; all day long they press their attack.

s: In the shadow of your wings
ch.t: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me— God sends forth his love and his faithfulness.
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns— whether they be green or dry—the wicked will be swept away.
See what they spew from their mouths— the words from their lips are sharp as swords, and they think, “Who can hear us?”

s: With God we shall do valiantly
ch.t: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

s: Lead me to the rock higher than I
ch.t: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
How long will you assault me? Would all of you throw me down— this leaning wall, this tottering fence?
I will be fully satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.

s: Hide me from the secret plots
ch.t: They plot injustice and say, “We have devised a perfect plan!” Surely the human mind and heart are cunning.

s: You crown the year with bounty
ch.t: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

s: Come and hear what God has done
ch.t: You let people ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.
May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples with equity and guide the nations of the earth.

s: Awesome is God from his sanctuary
ch.t: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

s: Save me, waters reach my neck
Zeal for your house consumes me
Answer me in your steadfast love
ch.t: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.
May those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

s: Do not forsake me in old age
ch.t: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, Sovereign Lord; I will proclaim your righteous deeds, yours alone.
May he defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; may he crush the oppressor.

s: Nearness of God is my good
ch.t: They are like a dream when one awakes; when you arise, Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.
Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

s: We give thanks, your name is near
ch.t: who says, “I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.”

s: You alone are to be feared
ch.t: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

s: Your way was through the sea
ch.t: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands, and I would not be comforted.

s: They flattered him with their lips
ch.t: God`s anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

s: Help us for your name's sake
ch.t: Help us, God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name`s sake.

s: You brought a vine out of Egypt
Restore us, O God of hosts
ch.t: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

s: Sing aloud to God our strength
I am the Lord your God
Oh that my people would listen
ch.t: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.

s: God presides in the divine council
You are gods, yet you shall die
ch.t: “The ‘gods` know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

s: O God, do not keep silence
ch.t: Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord— that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

s: How lovely is your dwelling place
Blessed are those who dwell in your house
ch.t: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

s: You restored the fortunes of Jacob
ch.t: I will listen to what God the Lord says; he promises peace to his people, his faithful servants— but let them not turn to folly.

s: Teach me your way, O Lord
Give me a sign of your favor
ch.t: Arrogant foes are attacking me, O God; ruthless people are trying to kill me— they have no regard for you.
Indeed, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her.”

s: My soul is full of troubles
ch.t: From my youth I have suffered and been close to death; I have borne your terrors and am in despair.

s: I will sing of steadfast love
If his sons forsake my law
ch.t: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you have established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

s: Lord, you have been our dwelling
We are consumed by your anger
Teach us to number our days
ch.t: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the whole world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

s: Because he holds fast to me
ch.t: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

s: It is good to give thanks
The righteous flourish like a palm
ch.t: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
The seas have lifted up, Lord, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

s: O God of vengeance, shine forth
Does he who disciplines not correct
ch.t: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.

s: Come, let us worship and bow down
ch.t: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

s: Sing to the Lord a new song
ch.t: Let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them; let all the trees of the forest sing for joy.

s: Light is sown for the righteous
ch.t: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

s: Sing a new song to the Lord
Make a joyful noise to the Lord
ch.t: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

s: The Lord reigns, he is holy
ch.t: The King is mighty, he loves justice— you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.
I will not look with approval on anything that is vile. I hate what faithless people do; I will have no part in it.

s: But you, O LORD, are enthroned forever
Of old you laid the foundation
ch.t: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

s: Bless the LORD, O my soul
Slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love
ch.t: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits—

s: You cause grass to grow for the livestock
When you send forth your Spirit
ch.t: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number— living things both large and small.

s: Give thanks, call upon his name
He sent a man ahead: Joseph
Moses and the plagues of Egypt
He brought them out with silver and gold
ch.t: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

s: We have sinned like our fathers
They forgot God who saved them
Yet he relented according to his steadfast love
ch.t: Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

s: They cried to the LORD in their trouble
Those who go down to the sea in ships
Let the wise attend to these things
ch.t: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

s: My heart is steadfast, O God
With God we shall do valiantly
ch.t: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Sukkoth.

s: Be not silent, O God of my praise
Help me, O LORD my God
ch.t: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.”

s: Great are the works of the LORD
ch.t: Praise the Lord. I will extol the Lord with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

s: Blessed is the one who fears the LORD
ch.t: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

s: From the rising of the sun to its setting
ch.t: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.

s: When Israel went out from Egypt
ch.t: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

s: Not to us, O LORD, but to your name
Trust in the LORD, he is their help
ch.t: They have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but cannot walk, nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

s: I love the LORD because he has heard
I will lift up the cup of salvation
ch.t: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came over me; I was overcome by distress and sorrow.
Praise the Lord, all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

s: The LORD is my strength and my song
ch.t: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: “The Lord`s right hand has done mighty things!

s: Aleph: Blessed are those whose way is blameless
Beth to Gimel: Open my eyes to wondrous things
Daleth to He: My soul clings to the dust
Waw to Zayin: Your word is my comfort
Heth to Teth: It is good that I was afflicted
Yodh to Kaph: Your hands have made me
Lamedh to Nun: Your word is a lamp to my feet
Samekh to Ayin: I hate the double-minded
Pe to Tsadhe: The sum of your word is truth
Qoph to Taw: I long for your salvation
ch.t: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

s: In my distress I called to the LORD
ch.t: He will punish you with a warrior`s sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom bush.

s: I lift my eyes to the hills
ch.t: I lift up my eyes to the mountains— where does my help come from?

s: I rejoiced when they said to me
ch.t: That is where the tribes go up— the tribes of the Lord— to praise the name of the Lord according to the statute given to Israel.

s: To you I lift up my eyes
ch.t: Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, for we have endured no end of contempt.

s: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side
ch.t: We have escaped like a bird from the fowler`s snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

s: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion
ch.t: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people both now and forevermore.
Those who go out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with them.

s: Unless the LORD builds the house
ch.t: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat— for he grants sleep to those he loves.

s: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD
ch.t: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.

s: Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth
ch.t: May those who pass by not say to them, “The blessing of the Lord be on you; we bless you in the name of the Lord.”

s: Out of the depths I cry to you
ch.t: Israel, put your hope in the Lord, for with the Lord is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.

s: My heart is not lifted up
ch.t: My heart is not proud, Lord, my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

s: Remember David and all his afflictions
The LORD swore to David a sure oath
ch.t: If your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever.”

s: How good when brothers dwell in unity
ch.t: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the Lord bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

s: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants
ch.t: Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord who minister by night in the house of the Lord.

s: Praise the name of the LORD
The idols of the nations are silver and gold
ch.t: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

s: His steadfast love endures forever: Creation
His steadfast love endures forever: Exodus
His steadfast love endures forever: Provision
ch.t: to him who led his people through the wilderness; His love endures forever.
Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is the one who repays you according to what you have done to us.

s: I give you thanks with my whole heart
ch.t: The Lord will vindicate me; your love, Lord, endures forever— do not abandon the works of your hands.

s: You have searched me and known me
I am fearfully and wonderfully made
ch.t: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
Keep me safe, Lord, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from the violent, who devise ways to trip my feet.

s: Set a guard over my mouth
ch.t: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

s: With my voice I cry out to the LORD
ch.t: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

s: Teach me to do your will
ch.t: Lord, hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.

s: Blessed be the LORD, my rock
Blessed are the people whose God is the LORD
ch.t: deliver me; rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

s: I will extol you, my God and King
Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom
ch.t: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord. Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

s: Put not your trust in princes
ch.t: the Lord gives sight to the blind, the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.

s: He sends out his word to the earth
ch.t: Praise the Lord. How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!
Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

s: Sing to the LORD a new song
ch.t: to carry out the sentence written against them— this is the glory of all his faithful people. Praise the Lord.

s: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD
ch.t: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.

s: Fear of the LORD is the beginning
Wisdom cries out in the streets
ch.t: Repent at my rebuke! Then I will pour out my thoughts to you, I will make known to you my teachings.

s: Wisdom guards from the evil way
Wisdom delivers from the forbidden woman
ch.t: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

s: Long life and peace through wisdom
Trust in the LORD with all your heart
Confidence and security in the LORD
Do not withhold good from others
ch.t: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

s: Instruction passed from father to son
The path of the righteous shines brighter
Guard your heart above all else
ch.t: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

s: Rejoice in the wife of your youth
ch.t: A loving doe, a graceful deer— may her breasts satisfy you always, may you ever be intoxicated with her love.

s: Warning against surety for a stranger
Learn from the ant, O sluggard
The worthless person and his schemes
ch.t: When you walk, they will guide you; when you sleep, they will watch over you; when you awake, they will speak to you.

s: Her house is the way to Sheol
ch.t: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

s: By me kings reign and rulers decree
I was beside him as a master craftsman
ch.t: To fear the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

s: Rebuke a wise man and he will love you
Folly sits at the door of her house
ch.t: Instruct the wise and they will be wiser still; teach the righteous and they will add to their learning.

s: A wise son makes a glad father
Blessings on the head of the righteous
Wisdom on the lips and love covers
The fear of the LORD prolongs life
ch.t: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

s: When it goes well with the righteous
One who waters will himself be watered
ch.t: Whoever puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to shake hands in pledge is safe.

s: The righteous cares for his beast
ch.t: From the fruit of their lips people are filled with good things, and the work of their hands brings them reward.

s: A wise son hears his father
Hope deferred makes the heart sick
Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise
A good man leaves an inheritance
ch.t: Whoever spares the rod hates their children, but the one who loves their children is careful to discipline them.

s: The wise woman builds her house
A way that seems right to a man
In the fear of the LORD is confidence
ch.t: Whoever oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

s: A soft answer turns away wrath
The eyes of the LORD are everywhere
Better a little with fear of the LORD
ch.t: Those who disregard discipline despise themselves, but the one who heeds correction gains understanding.

s: The heart plans, the LORD directs
Gray hair is a crown of glory
The lot is cast but the decision is the LORD's
ch.t: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

s: Better a dry morsel with quiet
A friend loves at all times
A cheerful heart is good medicine
Even a fool who keeps silent
ch.t: Whoever mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

s: The fool delights in airing his opinion
The name of the LORD is a strong tower
The lot puts an end to quarrels
A friend who sticks closer than a brother
ch.t: From the fruit of their mouth a person`s stomach is filled; with the harvest of their lips they are satisfied.

s: Better a poor man who walks in integrity
Good sense makes one slow to anger
Discipline your son while there is hope
The fear of the LORD leads to life
ch.t: A foolish child is a father`s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like the constant dripping of a leaky roof.

s: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler
Even a child makes himself known
Bread gained by deceit is sweet
The spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD
ch.t: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

s: The king's heart is a stream in the LORD's hand
Better to live in a corner of the housetop
ch.t: One who is wise can go up against the city of the mighty and pull down the stronghold in which they trust.

s: A good name is better than riches
Train up a child in the way he should go
Incline your ear to the words of the wise
Do not rob the poor or crush the afflicted
ch.t: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

s: When you sit to eat with a ruler
Do not move the ancient landmark
Buy truth and do not sell it
ch.t: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

s: Rescue those being led to death
The righteous falls seven times and rises
ch.t: for though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again, but the wicked stumble when calamity strikes.

s: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold
Coals of fire on your enemy's head
Ruling your spirit like a fortified city
ch.t: remove wicked officials from the king`s presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.

s: Honor is not fitting for a fool
The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes
A lying tongue hates its victims
ch.t: Their malice may be concealed by deception, but their wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

s: Faithful are the wounds of a friend
The heart of man reflects the man
Know well the condition of your flocks
ch.t: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if it is done for an outsider.

s: The wicked flee when no one pursues
A wicked ruler over a poor people
Whoever trusts in himself is a fool
ch.t: When a country is rebellious, it has many rulers, but a ruler with discernment and knowledge maintains order.

s: A man who hardens his neck
Where there is no vision the people perish
A man's pride will bring him low
The fear of man lays a snare
ch.t: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom`s instruction.

s: The words of Agur son of Jakeh
Two things I ask of you, O LORD
There is a generation that curses
Three things that are never satisfied
Four things the earth cannot bear
Four things small but exceedingly wise
Four things stately in their tread
ch.t: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.

s: An excellent wife who can find
Strength and dignity are her clothing
Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain
ch.t: She gets up while it is still night; she provides food for her family and portions for her female servants.
I have seen all the things that are done under the sun; all of them are meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

s: Wisdom and Folly Share One Fate
The Despair of Leaving Toil to Another
Enjoyment as Gift from God's Hand
ch.t: I hated all the things I had toiled for under the sun, because I must leave them to the one who comes after me.

s: Judgment Awaits, Yet All Return to Dust
ch.t: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens:
The youth may have come from prison to the kingship, or he may have been born in poverty within his kingdom.
or wealth lost through some misfortune, so that when they have children there is nothing left for them to inherit.
Better what the eye sees than the roving of the appetite. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.
The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.
When the sentence for a crime is not quickly carried out, people`s hearts are filled with schemes to do wrong.

s: Seize Life with All Your Might
Time and Chance Happen to All
ch.t: Go, eat your food with gladness, and drink your wine with a joyful heart, for God has already approved what you do.

s: Words of the Wise and Foolish
ch.t: and fools multiply words. No one knows what is coming— who can tell someone else what will happen after them?

s: Cast Your Bread on the Waters
ch.t: Invest in seven ventures, yes, in eight; you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.

s: The Final Verdict: All Is Vapor
The Epilogue: Words of the Wise
ch.t: Now all has been heard; here is the conclusion of the matter: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the duty of all mankind.

s: Where Do You Pasture Your Flock
ch.t: Dark am I, yet lovely, daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, like the tent curtains of Solomon.

s: Rose of Sharon, Lily of the Valleys
ch.t: Flowers appear on the earth; the season of singing has come, the cooing of doves is heard in our land.
All night long on my bed I looked for the one my heart loves; I looked for him but did not find him.
Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of incense.
His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as its cedars.
My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to browse in the gardens and to gather lilies.
and your mouth like the best wine. May the wine go straight to my beloved, flowing gently over lips and teeth.

s: If Only You Were My Brother
